title: Eveningcast
body:
![Eveningcast Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/230808c0fdd72162217600449c50381fb994e29a_0.webp)

**WARNING, YOU MAY NEED TO ENABLE SHADER PACKS YOURSELVES. THE SHADER USED IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH MACOS.**
## Through the Window

Eveningcast is Minecraft, but beautiful.

Shaders that make light actually look like light. Water you want to stare at. Textures that feel intentional. This is pure aesthetic. No new content, no mechanics to learn, no bloat. Just visuals that transform how your world looks and feels.

### What You Get

Pure Eye candy. Eveningcast gives you shader support through Iris, enhanced lighting and particle effects, improved animations, and refined textures for vanilla blocks and entities. Everything else stays exactly the same. Your world, your builds, your playstyle. Just better.

### Why It Exists

Because vanilla gameplay is good, but vanilla visuals could be better. Because your builds deserve to look as good as the effort you put into them. Because sometimes you just want your sunset to hit different. Because beauty matters, and Minecraft can be stunning without changing what makes it Minecraft.

Install it. Load your world. See what you've been missing.
